body: ## Problem When a rep runs the Power Dialer in one tab, every other Acquisity tab shows a "Resume session" card. It sits on top of the People and Deals toolbar (search, export, import, New) and has no way to close it, so the rep can't work with other leads in a second tab. Margaret reported this from the AI Acquisition Sales Team workspace. Closes ENG-15808 ## Solution The card now has a "Not in this tab" button. Clicking it hides the card in that tab only, so the toolbar is clickable again. The session keeps running in the dialling tab, and nothing is paused, claimed or ended. If the rep wants to dial from this tab later, Start Power Dialer still offers "Take over here". The card comes back on its own when a new session starts, or when this tab was dialling and another tab takes over. ## Scope - In: the v2 recovery card in tabs that don't own the session: a per-tab dismiss, kept across CRM page changes and refetches in that tab, scoped to the workspace and session. - Out: moving where the dialler layer sits by default (it also places the call pad and overlaps the record-page dialler work), a collapsed pill, the legacy bottom recovery bar, and the recovery polling. ## Blast radius The change is in the v2 Power Dialer session card and one optional input on the shared recovery hook. The legacy dialler calls the hook without that input, so it behaves as before. The tab that owns the session never shows the button, and the dismissal is only a sessionStorage flag, so it can't change session control or credentials. ## How it works ```mermaid flowchart LR B[Tab B on People] -->|session live in tab A| Card[Resume card] Card -->|Not in this tab| Hidden[Card hidden, toolbar clickable] Hidden -->|new session id| Card Hidden -->|Start Power Dialer| Prompt[Existing-session prompt: Take over here] ``` ### Resume card in a tab that isn't dialling (`/crm/people`, `/crm/deals`) The card now shows "Not in this tab" next to "Resume session" (or "Take over here" when this tab lost control). Dismissing stores `power-dialer:::recovery-dismissed:` in sessionStorage and stops the card registering as an active dialler surface, so the empty layer and its drag grip go away too. When it comes back: - A different session id: shown again. - This tab lost control after holding it: shown, even if a "resume" card was dismissed earlier, because that is a different kind. When the tab takes control again, its old "lost control" dismissal is cleared. - A live call on the session ending (`takeoverBlockedByLiveCall` going false): stays hidden. - sessionStorage blocked: hidden until the page reloads. No screenshots: showing this card needs a live Power Dialer session, which places real Twilio calls. See Notes. ## Verification - `bunx vitest run tests/components/crm-v2/phone/power-dialer-session-card.test.tsx`: 67 passed, including 9 new cases for dismiss, remount, a live call ending, another tab, another workspace, a new session, lost control, regaining control, blocked storage and the owning tab. - Mutation check: making the dismissal never apply fails 4 of the new cases; breaking the clear on regaining control fails 1. - `node design-system/kit/scripts/check-v2.mjs --changed`: 0 errors, 0 warnings. No local typecheck (machine rule), CI runs it. ## Notes - Schema / environment changes: none - Agent docs: `docs/agents/telephony.md` has a new line on the per-tab dismissal, its sessionStorage key and when the card comes back. - Preview: default (UI change, builds on its own). - Browser QA still needed on the preview: two tabs on People with a live session dialling a test number; dismiss in tab B, check search and New are clickable, then take over through Start Power Dialer. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith with what you need. --- ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **New Features** * Added a “Not in this tab” option to dismiss the Power Dialer recovery card without starting recovery. Dismissal is limited to the current tab and recovery session; the card can appear again if the session changes or dismissal state is cleared. * **Documentation** * Clarified how recovery-card dismissal works, when the card reappears, and how dismissed sessions can be resumed.
title: feat(crm): let a tab dismiss the Power Dialer resume card (ENG-15808)
